author: Carolyn Bennett
text:
After a bad dental experience left me anxious about going a friend recommended claregate dental practice. I made the call and booked a consultation the receptionist was very reassuring.
I went to see Arun who took time to make me feel comfortable and listened to my concerns.
He came up with a plan for my treatment that I was happy with.
I had deep cleaning with Becky the hygienist who was gentle and explained everything.
I am now not terrified of going as everyone at the practice is kind and patient. I do not dred every visit now I know I will be treated with consideration.
Thank you for restoring my trust.

author: 郭彤
text:
I would like to start with a big Thank You to all the lovely staff at Claregate Dental Practice! They have been so professional, so friendly and very supportive whenever I needed them. I used to terrified of visiting dentist, but this is the first time I actually have no fear when phoning to book appointments. Their reception team has been ever so helpful and always very friendly; their other staff are always very gentle and kind to me. Thank you, again.

Catherine

author: Hassina Summan
text: I saw Arun for the first time today and he was so patient as I explained my problem areas. He did some X-rays and talked me through the issues and most importantly how to fix them. He was honest with all the different types of treatment but said we could explore more if I wasn’t happy with initial treatment. I am pleased with the outcome, I would advise for anyone to book and see Arun. Thank you.

author: Lara
text:
I was extremely nervous after not going to the dentist for years but Liz and Katie made the entire experience so easy for me. They were both incredibly kind and reassuring and took the time to explain everything to me which made me feel so much calmer.
Not only that, but they fixed my problem straight away and made the whole visit comfortable and stress free. I am so grateful for how they both treated me, I could not recommend them more highly!

author: Teresa
text:
Best dentist ever 5 stars

Me and my husband have been with Claregate Dental Practice for many years now, they are very professional, the staff are lovely. Any problems are sorted very quickly and they always make you feel calm.

Keep up with the good work everyone.

Thanks
Teresa and Mark Lavender
